title: 주말에 뭐 해요? 공연·운동·동호회 낱말
objective: By the end, you can use ten leisure words, such as 동호회, 예매하다 and 관람하다, in short sentences about your free time.
summary: Learn ten intermediate words for talking about free time: going to shows and exhibitions, cheering at sports events, and joining clubs.

task.title: Use the leisure words
task.line: Choose, fill in, or put the words in order using the ten words from page 1.

words.meaning: free time, leisure (time away from work or study)
words.example: 요즘은 여가 시간에 주로 뭐 하세요?
words.exampleMeaning: What do you usually do in your free time these days?

words.meaning: club of people who share a hobby
words.example: 회사 등산 동호회에서 한 달에 한 번 산에 가요.
words.exampleMeaning: I go to the mountains once a month with my company hiking club.

words.meaning: to join (a club or group) as a member
words.example: 수영을 배우고 싶어서 동네 수영 모임에 가입했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I wanted to learn to swim, so I joined a local swimming group.

words.example: 우리 사진 모임은 회원끼리 사이가 아주 좋아요.
words.exampleMeaning: The members of our photo club get along really well.

words.meaning: to enjoy and appreciate (music, art, a film)
words.exampleMeaning: On weekends I relax at home and enjoy listening to music.

words.meaning: to watch (a show, game or exhibition) as a member of the audience
words.example: 공연 중에는 사진을 찍지 말고 조용히 관람해 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please watch quietly and do not take photos during the performance.

words.example: 미술관에서 하는 그림 전시회에 같이 갈래요?
words.exampleMeaning: Do you want to go to the painting exhibition at the art museum with me?

words.example: 인기 있는 뮤지컬은 빨리 예매해야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: You have to book tickets for popular musicals early.

words.meaning: to cheer for (a team or player)
words.exampleMeaning: I went to the ballpark to cheer for our team.

words.meaning: to take part in (a contest, race or event)
words.example: 다음 달 마라톤 대회에 참가하기로 했어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I decided to run in a marathon next month.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 콘서트 표를 인터넷으로 (예매했어요 / 응원했어요). ② 영화관에서 영화를 (관람할 / 가입할) 때는 휴대폰을 꺼 주세요. ③ 조용한 카페에서 클래식 음악을 (감상했어요 / 참가했어요).
Choose the right verb for each situation: ① 탁구 동호회에 처음 들어가서 회원이 돼요. (가입하다 / 참가하다) ② 이번 토요일에 동네 달리기 대회에 나가요. (가입하다 / 참가하다)
Fill in the blank with 응원하다 in the past tense: 지난 월드컵 때 친구들과 광장에서 우리나라 선수들을 ____.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 이 독서 모임의 ____은 모두 스무 명이에요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 퇴근 후 ____ 시간에 기타를 배우고 있어요.
Put the words in order: 갔어요 / 전시회에 / 지난주에 / 사진
answers: ① 예매했어요 ② 관람할 ③ 감상했어요
지난주에 사진 전시회에 갔어요. (사진 전시회에 지난주에 갔어요.)
